market_summary: During the London session, all four pairs are consolidating within or around session value areas with sub-2.0 RVOL, lacking institutional volume breakouts. EURUSD and GBPUSD are testing resistance near session highs and VAH with muted volume, while XAUUSD and BTCUSD are attempting mean-reverting bounces below declining VWAP and EMA50 baselines. Confluence remains insufficient for high-conviction momentum scalp entries across all symbols, prompting a full HOLD batch.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (3969.92) and below POC (3978.28), confirming strong session value area discount. Cumulative delta is -3.14 (BEARISH) aligning with the broader downtrend, though short-term slope shows slight counter-pressure (+1.44). In LONDON_SESSION, price is trading deeply below VWAP (3972.12) and EMA50 (3970.44). The signal bar bounced from near the -2 ATR channel band (3936.39) after testing Session Low (3924.30), but RVOL remains low at 0.601 with no yellow volume spike confirming a bottom reversal. Currently retesting EMA20 mid-channel baseline from underneath. With GEX null and no high-volume breakout or structural break of S/R (3968.55), a mean-reverting bounce without confirmation warrants a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping vwap and ema50
signals.level_event: rejection of session low with pullback toward ema20

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10773 to VAH 1.10981) right at the POC (1.10946) and pressing against VAH. Cumulative delta is +5,312 (BULLISH) with positive slope (+4660.67), agreeing with the upward momentum. In LONDON_SESSION, price is holding above VWAP (1.10850) and EMA50 (1.10883). However, the forming bar and live price (1.10975) are pinned right against the upper ATR band (1.10977), Session High (1.10988), and horizontal resistance S/R (1.11007). RVOL is low at 0.824 without yellow breakout volume. Buying directly into overhead resistance and VAH without volume expansion is unfavorable. GEX is null. Prudent stance is HOLD.
signals.level_event: acceptance above vwap pressing session high

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593 to VAH 1.32797) hovering right around POC (1.32738). Cumulative delta is -1,339 (NEUTRAL), showing lack of clear directional conviction. In LONDON_SESSION, price is chopping just above VWAP (1.32663) and EMA50 (1.32696), remaining pinned below Session High (1.32809) and the upper ATR envelope (1.32800). RVOL is muted at 0.761 with no yellow volume spikes. Lacking directional delta agreement and sitting directly between POC and overhead Session High resistance, the setup is mid-range chop. GEX is null. Action is HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral slightly above flat vwap and ema50

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (73397.14) and below POC (73541.61), with the forming bar trying to reclaim VAL from below. CVD is -0.04 (BEARISH) with flat slope (-0.0), matching the prevailing intraday downtrend. During LONDON_SESSION, price remains structurally below VWAP (73612.03) and EMA50 (73618.59). The signal bar wicked into support S/R (73284.6) and held above Session Low (73166.0), but the rebound is mid-channel between the lower ATR band (73112.26) and EMA20/VWAP. RVOL is 1.171 without any yellow spike confirmation. Buying into resistance overhead or selling into support after a sweep lacks edge. GEX is null. Setup is a clear HOLD.
signals.level_event: sweep of local support s/r 73284.6 followed by bounce
